text:
maria: Heads up — I've been running long-context stress (token seq ~120k) on the paged KV path and seeing steady VRAM growth until OOM on H100. Looks like evicted page metadata isn't being reclaimed, fragmentation count climbs.
maria: quick log excerpt:
```
[2026-02-12T03:14:12Z] kvcache: evict cascade start -> dropped 384 pages
[2026-02-12T03:14:12Z] pagetable: mark-evicted id=0x7f3a2c page_idx=1248 owner=slot42
[2026-02-12T03:14:12Z] kvcache: shadow-meta keep=154, in_use=230, fragments=87
[2026-02-12T03:14:12Z] kvcache: free-list len=0, allocator backpressure=1
[2026-02-12T03:14:12Z] pagetable: remap request stalled (gpu-sync)
```

maria: Repro is deterministic on our H100 pool; interestingly MI250x runs the same workload but OOM path is different — pages pile up then we get long pagewalk stalls.
adesh: :eyes: which runtime flags / kernel combo are you using? batching/batcher=continuous? quantized kernels?
maria: default CI config: batcher=adaptive, batch_size_target=256, kv_page_size=64k, reuse_window=4096, prefetch=on, kernelset=auto. I tried forcing legacy kernels, still see growth but timing shifts.
sophia: any traces from kv-cache telemetry? frag counts over time would help.
maria: here's a short prometheus dump (samples every 30s):
```
time,frag_count,in_use,free_list_len
00:00,12,210,4
00:30,18,224,2
01:00,31,236,0
01:30,47,241,0
02:00,65,248,0
```

maria: Also saw repeated "pagetable: remap request stalled (gpu-sync)" entries coinciding with spikes in CPU-side latency for page reclamation.
perfbot: perf snapshot attached: kernel stalls ~7.6% time inside pagewalk handler, PT shadow lock hold avg=12.3ms, PT lookup retries=8423, nvlink packet drops=0
andrew: my 2¢ — sounds like a handoff ordering bug between async evict completion and page table compaction. If the compaction runs while a stale owner reference is still queued on the GPU, we can end up with ghost fragments that never hit free-list.
andrew: H100/driver differences could expose concurrency windows — MI seems to hide it because remap stalls dominate earlier.
maria: I dumped the kvcache shadow entries and found many with tombstone=true but refcount==0 and not returned to free-list.
adesh: did you bisect to a commit? any recent pager/allocator churn?
infra-bot: deploy: runtime-main @ 2026-02-10T21:00 UTC -> rolled runtime: kv-pager: async-complete->defer-compact (commit e5f9b1d)
maria: yep that deploy lines up. I bisected to e5f9b1d as the first bad commit — previously compaction was synchronous on evict completion.
sophia: nice find. so deferring compaction introduced the window. can we add a safety fence (atomic state + generation) before deferring?
andrew: proposed hotfix patch (pseudocode):
```
// ensure compaction sees latest owner stamp
if (atomic_read(&page->owner_gen) != observed_gen) {
  // requeue compaction but don't mark tombstone permanent
  requeue_compaction(page);
  return;
}
compact_page(page);
```

maria: quick test with that guard + forcing compaction retry reduced fragments: frag_count plateaued at ~18 over 2 hours instead of climbing.
adesh: can you push perf runs with the guard across H100/MI nodes? want to verify no perf regressions for hotpath.
maria: running now — will post benchmarks in ~30m. early numbers: +0.3% CPU in reclaim path, pagewalk stall down 80%.
perfbot: end-to-end memory usage delta (guard patch) across 2h: H100: -23% peak VRAM; MI250x: -11% peak VRAM. Latency p50: +4ms on reclaim-heavy traces.
andrew: long-term we should revisit the deferred compaction scheduling — maybe make it epoch-driven vs naive defer. Defer was to avoid stall spikes but exposed correctness window.
sophia: filing a short issue + test harness (repro script + artifact traces) so QA can validate across firmware/driver combos. @maria can you attach the repro command and sample seed?
maria: repro: ci/inference/tests/longctx_repro.sh --seed 90210 --gpu h100-spot-22 --tokens 120k --kv-paged --page-size 64k
maria: logs + dump uploaded to /mnt/ci-artifacts/5723456789/
adesh: thanks — I'll take ownership of the bugfix PR, include patch + unit test that simulates eviction-compaction races and run cross-arch perf matrix.
maria: thanks all. putting a note on the incident board. :thumbsup:
